chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, used to request Zamzam water while he was in Madinah.

key_terms.رَسُولُ: the Messenger, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.زَمْزَمَ: Zamzam, the blessed well of Makkah
key_terms.يَسْتَهْدِي: he would request or seek to be sent

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله request Zamzam water while in Madinah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله used to request Zamzam water even while residing in Madinah. It indicates the recognized virtue and special status of Zamzam water in the Prophetic sunnah (prophetic tradition), especially in connection with hajj.
